description: Add a task to an ADDITIONAL list (multi-homing). This does NOT move the task: its home list is unchanged and it may not appear in the target list's task query. Requires the paid Tasks-in-Multiple-Lists feature. There is no API to move a task between lists - use the ClickUp web UI (right-click -> Move) to preserve the custom ID and history.

task_id.description: ClickUp task ID: internal (e.g. 86caqr85m) or custom (e.g. DEV-1217)

name: clickup_add_task_to_list
